clips.title: The story
paras: At Thalanaar, on the border of Feralas and the Thousand Needles, Falfindel Waywarder sends adventurers after Charlga Razorflank. Henrig Lonebrow's recovered journal reveals the growing danger inside Razorfen Kraul.

At secluded Thalanaar, the night elf outpost, Falfindel Waywarder grieves for the druid Heralath and the dwarf Henrig Lonebrow. Lonebrow traveled with the Explorers' League before the quilboar captured him. He escaped Razorfen Kraul, but died on the road, leaving a tattered journal that describes the growing menace inside. There is no time to send a runner to Darnassus for military reinforcements. Falfindel sends passing adventurers into the thorned dens to face the danger at its heart.

Charlga Razorflank is an ancient geomancer and ruthless matriarch who has united the fractious Razorfen quilboar under her iron rule. From deep within the Kraul, she marshals a bristling army that threatens neighboring lands. Thick thorn mazes, battlement walls, and swarms of fanatical quilboar warriors guard the way to Charlga. Her medallion, taken from her lifeless body, will prove her downfall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Poor Heralath! And this dwarf... Lonebrow. What a brave soul he was.
We must not let their valiance go for naught. This crone... Charlga Razorflank... Must be stopped.
Surely, infiltrating the Kraul will be perilous. There isn't time to send word to Darnassus. Friend, assemble a party to slay the crone.
Bring me Razorflank's Medallion as proof of demise.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So long as Charlga Razorflank is mustering a force in Razorfen Kraul, these lands are in great danger.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The crone has been laid to rest. This is fantastic news, friend.
In these times of peril, it is refreshing to see one as brave as yourself.
With Razorflank's minions taken care of, our studies in the area can continue. Perhaps now we can gain further knowledge of exactly what happened to corrupt the resting place of Agamaggan.
However, I fear the answer to that question lies in treachery as well...
